h2. Description

*Tech View's cells should follow the design*: the number as a blue link, Progress as a thin bar with the percentage beside it, and the advisor's avatar before the name. On staging none of the three shows.

For example,
* the work order number is black, not the link blue
* Progress shows only a grey "0%" label, with no bar, at Compact, Regular and Comfortable
* the Service Advisor cell shows the name only, with no avatar

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10045*), the PRD and the design.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Tech View* in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar).
#* The number (e.g. *S2-36127*) is black; Progress shows only "0%"; Service Advisor shows the name with no avatar.
# Click the density button and choose *Compact*, then *Comfortable*.
#* No progress bar shows at either density.

*Actual Result:*
* Black number, no progress bar at any density, no advisor avatar.

*Expected Result:*
* The cells follow the design, as the tests expect: *"Step 3: the number shows in the blue used for links, the same blue as the numbers in the design picture, not in black."* and *"Step 4: a thin rounded bar with the percentage beside it in small grey text (for example 0%), as in the picture: in the design the bar is 64 × 6 px, about as long as the word "Progress" in the header and much thinner than the text. Any filled part of the bar is blue."*
